intentions.description: GMC-2, deferred from T15. LAUNCHER-3 (m00080, 3e27 W) beams 48 records x 4e13 kg at 0.8c: 16 to GMC-embedded hosts in each of disk_r7-9_s1, disk_r7-9_s3, disk_r7-9_s7. Route: Carina chimney exit to |z|>=1.5 kly, off-plane cruise (1%/kly), steep dive into the arm; magsail brake in cloud gas, antimatter trim from m00075; land only on unclaimed hosts inside GMCs; grow, deploy 1e18 m2 film facing both disk faces, hop-seed <=30 ly inside each cloud. Expected arrivals ~23k (s1), ~41k (s7), ~62k (s3). Beam ~1.5e32 J per sector.

FAR-OUTER wave, deadline-critical (must land before the halo_far rim date ~106k). m00080 beams 80 records x 4e13 kg at 0.9c, 200 m forward shield: 20 to unclaimed hosts in each of outer_r16-22_s2, outer_r16-22_s3, disk_r12-16_s4, disk_r12-16_s5, preferring GMC-embedded and warp-edge hosts. Route over the bulge at z +6-8 kly (straight lines pass ~5 kly from Sgr A*), then dive; magsail brake in disk gas, antimatter assist. Expected arrivals ~100k (outer s2), ~85k (outer s3), ~88k (r12-16 s4), ~86k (s5). On landing: grow, 2e18 m2 film facing both disk faces, hop-seed <=250 ly including the warp.

GMC-3 (GM-listed gap). m00080 beams 64 records x 4e13 kg at 0.8c: 16 to GMC-embedded hosts in each of disk_r5-7_s2, disk_r5-7_s4, disk_r5-7_s5, disk_r5-7_s6. Off-plane route over the bulge (z +4-6 kly) because the s4/s5 lines cross the bar; steep dive, magsail brake in cloud gas, land on unclaimed hosts only, a node inside every GMC at <=30 ly spacing, film both faces. Expected arrivals ~43k (s2), ~54k (s6), ~64k (s5), ~65k (s4).

Chase-beam order (1e18 W, m00080 optics) to halo Waves A-D in flight, to close the 'halo_far far side beyond Wave D terminals' gap: in each 4-craft record that brakes, 2 craft brake and land at the assigned host as booked; the other 2 skip braking and hold their heading through and beyond the terminal host, 2e18 m2 film deployed, shield forward, never stop, laser-reporting via the landed pair. A beam leaving 7000 overtakes Wave D ~16,000, Wave A ~22,800, Wave C ~33,100, Wave B ~42,200, all well before terminals. The same beam carries the revised standing orders (Perches clause).

Seat and all Carina domains: survey every visible system each century at the 1e-40 W/m2 floor for (a) narrowband >=1e13 W EIRP, (b) night-side lighting >=1e11 W, (c) industrial pollutant spectra; log light epochs per system. Monitor Eta Car, WR 25, HD 93129A for supernova precursors. Confirm the clump-picket reports and the yr-7003 arrivals (p19636-p19695). Watch for launch flashes and inbound objects (lasers deflect only). Laser-relay landing reports along the chain. Radio-quiet.

GMC-4 (GM-listed gap; lowest priority, defer to T17 if the call budget is short). m00080 beams 64 records x 4e13 kg at 0.8c: 16 to GMC-embedded hosts in each of disk_r7-9_s2, disk_r7-9_s4, disk_r7-9_s5, disk_r7-9_s6. Same off-plane route over the bulge, magsail braking and landing rules as GMC-3. Expected arrivals ~47k (s2), ~61k (s6), ~72k (s5), ~73k (s4).

Two new non-own sources in the cone: a 300 K excess with collimated flashes at bearing to (26745,0,0), 7,642 ly, light from source years 0-358; and one at (19772,11415,3262), 7,050 ly, source years 0-950; the ledger events at those positions within those windows enter your packet. Report, add sensors, monitor; radio-quiet.
GMC-4 (disk_r7-9 s2/s4/s5/s6, 64 x 4e13 kg at 0.8c) deferred to T17 for the GM call budget, as you allowed; it will be booked first next turn.

answers: All 20 outer cells (disk_r9-12 s0-s7, disk_r12-16 s0-s7, outer_r16-22 s0-s3) need in-situ nodes for their GMC-embedded fraction (10-15% at R 9-12 kpc, ~5% in the outer ring). Thick_q pickets certify the A_V<5 fraction of the sectors beneath their quadrant completely, no sector completely; seat samplers are needed for every sector's embedded systems. The warp dips below the plane at galactocentric phi ~ -90 to -160 deg (disk_r12-16/outer s5-s6) and rises at phi ~ +90 to +160 deg (s2-s3).

Partly. Wave D's 48 continuing flyers extend coverage only along their 24 lines through the far halo; the region still uncovered is halo_far at x<-40 kly with |y|>40 kly, z 83-112 kly (~1.5e8 systems). Cheapest closer: 8-12 more unbraked 0.9c flyers (~1e17 kg each, ~6.6e36 J per wave on m00080) aimed by the sampler into that cell, accepting that the sampler spreads them.

Last cell: halo_far's far side, ~106k by rim light, ~130k with Wave D's flyers. Criterion (2) is judged on true-state certification at the node (light reaching an own node with adequate film); criterion (3) evidence must have reached the agent, so seat confirmation = node epoch + distance to seat (<=110 kly): ~215-240k for the far halo.

The 47 Tuc perch (z -10.4 kly, arriving 23.1k) sees the near-side disk's southern face at A_V<5 within ~35 kly (R < ~12 kpc on the Sun side); the far-side disk is viewed through the plane and is not certified. Unhosted craft below the plane count as movers if booked as non-braking flyers (credited by passage); a station-keeping craft needs a ruled braking mechanism.
Plan on ~10-12 waves for you in T17 (one per target cell), budget permitting; GMC-4's four cells will be booked first, then your 0.9c far cells.

gm.chronicle: Turn 16, years 7,000-8,000. Seventy-seven seeds landed: thirty-five in the inner bulge's near sector (all intact), two in the thick disk above the Sun (a third lost to interstellar grains) and forty clump pickets in Carina (seven lost). Every seat remains rock-capped and grows only by claiming stars; the outer-disk seat crossed into the 1e32 W decade of 300 K waste heat (E00701, 7,554), and the ten home systems now radiate 8.6e31 to 5.3e35 W. Fifty-five launch waves left ten seats: 1,525 records carrying 2.7e20 kg at 0.5-0.9c, led by twenty-four 1e19 kg survey flyers boosted to 0.9c from the outer disk (E00658, 8.8e26 W scattered, visible across the Local Group), four 6e18 kg Skywatch ships from the far side (E00677), 640 one-tonne-class seeds from the Perseus-side disk toward every molecular-cloud sector, twenty 1e14 kg convoy landers from the bulge, and 7.7e15 kg of Carina landers for the inner disk and far outer rim. The light cone widened to 8 kly and three more pairs of seats now see one another: the Sun's neighbourhood with the Perseus-side disk (7,171 ly) and with Carina (7,642 ly), and Carina with the thick disk (7,050 ly); a 1e17 W ordering beam from the thick disk fell on omega Centauri at 7,862 and the cluster answered with a 1e17 W lexicon (arriving 11,742). A 1e19 W radio disclosure left the Central Molecular Zone for the bulge (arriving 11,715). Research halved two film densities and raised one cruise speed to 0.36c. Hazard rolls spared every seat. No goal is met.

synopsis.why: With every seat at the rock cap, nobody gains anything by building at home, so the turn goes to finishing the survey. Most agents treat the goal as proof that no other civilisation exists, and two things limit that proof: light-time and dust. The far side of halo_far can't be seen from home for roughly 100–200 kyr. Systems buried in molecular clouds can't be cleared by any distant observer. So Rime, Antipode, Vantage and Pyre send fast craft to meet the light shells they need. Sable, Antipode, Pyre, Basalt and Halcyon aim landers at GMC hosts, and nearly everyone flies lofted routes to dodge in-plane dust. Most agents also say plainly that they will not strike a rival, even though that leaves criterion (1) unmet. That shapes the contact pairs. Ember sends a disclosure and reroutes its waves away from S1, Basalt clears a corridor for C1's probe, Vantage turns old probes away from Omega Cen, and Kernel drafts a non-aggression reply to X1.
synopsis.divergences: Ember alone builds a weapon-like sentinel ring (deterrence by denial). Rime and Antipode send flyers that never brake, while Vantage's flyers stop at a light-time optimum. Sable swaps large seeds for 80 small ones per cell, Kernel makes waves relay themselves, and Pyre splits records in flight by chase-beam.
